text: btw 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的并行侧聊插件，在主会话右侧栏打开独立的会话面板。它创建继承主会话工作区、工具、权限和模型选择的子会话，并将最近对话摘要作为上下文。用户可以通过侧栏按钮、/side 或 /btw 命令及快捷键打开或新建侧聊；主会话和侧聊还可分别使用 send_to_side 与 send_to_main 传递消息。适合希望并行处理问题、同时保留主线对话背景的 DSH 用户。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 或更高版本，不需额外 API Key。

btw adds parallel side chats to DSH Web's right sidebar. Child chats inherit the main session's workspace, tools, permissions, model, and recent context. Open them with /side, /btw, a shortcut, or the sidebar. send_to_side and send_to_main pass messages between chats. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1+.
我想在主会话旁边开个独立对话，同时带上最近的聊天背景。
能不能在 DSH 右侧栏并行处理另一个问题？
让另一个对话沿用当前会话的模型和工作区。
我想让主线程把一个子任务交给侧边的会话，再把结果发回来。
有没有快捷方式可以快速打开最近的并行聊天？
我关掉侧聊标签后，希望它不要再自动出现。
Can I run a separate conversation beside my main DSH thread with recent context carried over?
I want the main agent to delegate a question to a parallel chat and receive its findings back.
btw 的功能「带上下文创建侧聊」：在当前 DSH 会话旁创建独立子会话，继承模型路由、权限预设和工作区，并注入近期主会话摘要。通过侧栏新建按钮触发。
btw 的功能「主侧聊消息互传」：主会话可用 send_to_side 向最近或指定侧聊发送任务，侧聊可用 send_to_main 将发现作为消息发回主会话。
btw 的功能「命令与快捷键打开」：通过 /side、/btw 命令或主键加 Alt+S 快捷键打开最近侧聊；若尚无侧聊则创建一个。
btw 的功能「恢复未关闭侧聊」：主会话重新加载后，根据子会话记录恢复仍打开的侧聊，并略过已关闭的项目；再次打开时重新连接子 Agent。
btw 的功能「关闭并记住侧聊」：关闭右侧标签时取消并释放子 Agent，将会话 ID 写入关闭标记，避免后续恢复该侧聊。
btw 使用 DSH_HOME 指定数据目录，或默认写入用户目录下的 .dsh/btw/closed.json；关闭侧聊仅记录关闭状态，相关会话日志仍由 DSH 保存在本机。
侧聊上下文是在创建或重新连接时从主会话读取的近期消息摘要；后续主会话的新消息不会自动同步到已打开的侧聊。

btw README · btw：btw is an external plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), the desktop coding-agent app. It adds parallel side chats to the right sidebar of any DSH conversation. A side chat runs beside the main thread, inherits its workspace, tools, permissions, model, and reasoning effort, and starts with a digest of the main conversation. The side-chat tab renders the **shared conversation surface**, so composing, queuing, attachments, tool cards, Markdown, and scrolling behave exactly like the main thread.

btw README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or newer (the `engines.dsh` floor in `package.json`).
- A DSH profile to install into; the desktop profile is shown below.
- btw is not a standalone app: the host half runs inside the DSH host, and the client half is a DSH Web client plugin. It plugs into DSH's `resources`, `sessions`, `sidebarRightTabs`, `sidebarRight`, `slots`, `commandUi`, `shortcuts`, and `locale` services, and renders DSH's shared `conversation.content` factory.

btw README · How it works：- A side chat is an ordinary hidden Session: `meta.parentSession` records lineage, and the session is archived right after creation, so it stays out of the session lists.
- The client does not paint a custom chat panel. Each side chat is a **resource tab**:
  - address: `dsh-resource://btw/session/<child>?parent=<parent>`
  - the resource provider calls `/attach` first (so the child Agent is live), refreshes the session catalog, then `sessions.retain()`
  - the tab body binds the child with `SessionProvider` and renders `conversation.content` with `variant: 'embedded'`
  - therefore the composer, image paste/attachments, queued messages, tool cards, thinking, Markdown, and scroll-follow all come from the main-thread components
- Archive and sending: the shared Composer prompts the child session directly. A **prepended** `agent/pre-step` listener unarchives the child before the archived-session gate runs; `agent/status` re-archives it once the agent is idle.
- Context is injected as system-prompt sections: at fork time the host reads the parent transcript, keeps roughly the last 10 messages / 6000 characters, and adds `btw:context` (`interpolate: false`) pl

btw README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/btw
```

After changing code, run `pnpm build` and restart the app. The host snapshots client bundles at boot, so reloading the page is not enough.
btw README · Usage：UI copy comes from the DSH locale service (zh/en) and follows the app language; it is not hardcoded in the component.

btw README · Usage：- `⌘⌥S`, `/side`, or `/btw`: open the most recent side chat; create one when none exists.
- The `+` in the tab header starts another side chat.
- Closing the tab's `×` closes and deletes that side chat.
- The tab title follows the session title after the first message; before that it reads "Side chat".
- The main thread can call `send_to_side`; a side chat can call `send_to_main`.

btw README · Limits：- The context is a snapshot taken at attach time; later messages in the main conversation are not synchronized automatically.
- DSH's session persistence layer has no delete API, so closing a side chat only disposes the agent and writes a tombstone; the `btw-*` log stays under `~/.dsh/sessions`.
- Host routes accept loopback requests only.
